test_cases.description: Verify that session-summary.json schema accepts a valid `rejected_approaches` array with objects containing `approach` and `reason` keys.
preconditions: The session-summary.json schema definition is available in the agentfox package
A JSON validator or schema parser is importable
test_cases.expected: The document is parsed as valid with no schema validation errors; `rejected_approaches` is accessible as a list with one entry.

data = parse_session_summary(input_json)
assert data['rejected_approaches'][0]['approach'] == 'Used library Y'

test_cases.description: Verify that `compose_enriched_summary` always returns a string beginning with the original narrative summary text.

input.summary: Used a two-pass algorithm for performance.

test_cases.expected: Return value is a non-empty string starting with 'Used a two-pass algorithm for performance.'
test_cases.assertion_pseudocode:
result = compose_enriched_summary(summary='Used a two-pass algorithm for performance.', rejected_approaches=[], gotchas=[], assumptions=[])
assert result.startswith('Used a two-pass algorithm for performance.')
assert len(result) > 0

test_cases.description: Verify that `compose_enriched_summary` appends rejected approaches formatted as 'Tried: {approach} — rejected because: {reason}' when entries are present.
test_cases.expected: Returned string contains 'Tried: Redis cache — rejected because: Adds an external dependency' and 'Tried: In-memory dict — rejected because: Not thread-safe', each on separate lines.
test_cases.assertion_pseudocode:
result = compose_enriched_summary(summary='Implemented caching layer.', rejected_approaches=[{'approach': 'Redis cache', 'reason': 'Adds an external dependency'}, {'approach': 'In-memory dict', 'reason': 'Not thread-safe'}], gotchas=[], assumptions=[])
assert 'Tried: Redis cache — rejected because: Adds an external dependency' in result
assert 'Tried: In-memory dict — rejected because: Not thread-safe' in result
lines = result.split('\n')
assert any('Tried: Redis cache' in l for l in lines)
assert any('Tried: In-memory dict' in l for l in lines)

test_cases.description: Verify that `compose_enriched_summary` appends gotchas formatted as 'Watch out: {gotcha}' when entries are present.

gotchas: Empty arrays serialize as null in some paths

test_cases.expected: Returned string contains 'Watch out: DuckDB closes connection on fork' and 'Watch out: Empty arrays serialize as null in some paths', each on separate lines.
test_cases.assertion_pseudocode:
result = compose_enriched_summary(summary='Refactored the formatter.', rejected_approaches=[], gotchas=['DuckDB closes connection on fork', 'Empty arrays serialize as null in some paths'], assumptions=[])
assert 'Watch out: DuckDB closes connection on fork' in result
assert 'Watch out: Empty arrays serialize as null in some paths' in result

test_cases.description: Verify that `compose_enriched_summary` appends assumptions formatted as 'Assumes: {assumption}' when entries are present.
test_cases.expected: Returned string contains 'Assumes: Spec 10 retains session_summaries table' and 'Assumes: DuckDB version >= 0.9', each on separate lines.
test_cases.assertion_pseudocode:
result = compose_enriched_summary(summary='Added retry logic.', rejected_approaches=[], gotchas=[], assumptions=['Spec 10 retains session_summaries table', 'DuckDB version >= 0.9'])
assert 'Assumes: Spec 10 retains session_summaries table' in result
assert 'Assumes: DuckDB version >= 0.9' in result

test_cases.description: Verify that the session lifecycle calls `compose_enriched_summary` and stores the composed text in the `session_summaries` DuckDB table.
preconditions: DuckDB knowledge store is initialised with a `session_summaries` table
A valid session-summary.json with structured fields is available on disk
`session_lifecycle.py` has been updated with the `compose_enriched_summary` integration

gotchas: Index does not cover NULL values

test_cases.expected: The `session_summaries` table contains exactly one row for this session whose summary column contains 'Tried: Full table scan — rejected because: Too slow', 'Watch out: Index does not cover NULL values', and 'Assumes: Table size stays under 1M rows'.
test_cases.assertion_pseudocode:
process_session_summary(session_summary_json)
row = db.query('SELECT summary FROM session_summaries WHERE session_id = ?', session_id)
assert 'Tried: Full table scan — rejected because: Too slow' in row['summary']
assert 'Watch out: Index does not cover NULL values' in row['summary']
assert 'Assumes: Table size stays under 1M rows' in row['summary']

test_cases.description: Verify that `compose_enriched_summary` returns the raw summary unchanged when no structured fields are present.
test_cases.expected: Return value equals exactly 'Implemented task group 3 for spec 11.' with no additional lines or characters.
test_cases.assertion_pseudocode:
result = compose_enriched_summary(summary='Implemented task group 3 for spec 11.', rejected_approaches=None, gotchas=None, assumptions=None)
assert result == 'Implemented task group 3 for spec 11.'

property_tests.description: For any session-summary.json without the three new structured fields, `compose_enriched_summary` returns a string identical to the original `summary` field value.
property_tests.for_any_strategy: Generate random non-empty summary strings (alphanumeric, 1–2000 chars). Call compose_enriched_summary with the summary and all structured fields as None or empty.
property_tests.invariant_check:
result = compose_enriched_summary(summary=s, rejected_approaches=None, gotchas=None, assumptions=None)
assert result == s

result2 = compose_enriched_summary(summary=s, rejected_approaches=[], gotchas=[], assumptions=[])
assert result2 == s

property_tests.description: For any reviewer session with zero findings or verifier session with zero verdicts, `generate_archetype_summary` always returns None and no row is written to session_summaries.
property_tests.for_any_strategy: Generate reviewer sessions with empty findings lists and verifier sessions with empty verdicts lists. Process each through the session lifecycle with a test DuckDB instance.
property_tests.invariant_check:
result = generate_archetype_summary(session_type='reviewer', findings=[])
assert result is None

result2 = generate_archetype_summary(session_type='verifier', verdicts=[])
assert result2 is None

process_session(session_type='reviewer', findings=[], session_id=sid)
count = db.query('SELECT count(*) FROM session_summaries WHERE session_id = ?', sid)[0][0]
assert count == 0

property_tests.description: For any session-summary.json with at least one non-empty structured field, every entry in every populated field appears in the stored session_summaries text using the prescribed format strings.
property_tests.for_any_strategy: Generate session summaries with random combinations of non-empty rejected_approaches (1–5 entries), gotchas (1–5 strings), and assumptions (1–5 strings). Process through compose_enriched_summary and verify all entries appear.

property_tests.description: For any reviewer session with one or more findings, `generate_archetype_summary` returns a non-empty string and a row is written to session_summaries.
property_tests.for_any_strategy: Generate reviewer sessions with 1–10 findings (random severities and description strings). Process through generate_archetype_summary and the session lifecycle.
property_tests.invariant_check:
result = generate_archetype_summary(session_type='reviewer', findings=findings)
assert result is not None
assert len(result) > 0

process_session(session_type='reviewer', findings=findings, session_id=sid)
count = db.query('SELECT count(*) FROM session_summaries WHERE session_id = ?', sid)[0][0]
assert count == 1

edge_case_tests.description: Verify that `compose_enriched_summary` skips a malformed `rejected_approaches` entry missing the `approach` key without raising an exception.
edge_case_tests.expected: No exception is raised; the malformed entry (missing `approach`) is skipped; the valid entry is formatted and present in the returned string.
edge_case_tests.assertion_pseudocode:
result = compose_enriched_summary(summary='Some narrative.', rejected_approaches=[{'reason': 'Too slow'}, {'approach': 'Valid approach', 'reason': 'Not compatible'}], gotchas=[], assumptions=[])
assert 'Tried: Valid approach — rejected because: Not compatible' in result
assert 'Too slow' not in result or 'Tried:' not in result.split('Too slow')[0].split('\n')[-1]

edge_case_tests.description: Verify that `compose_enriched_summary` handles an empty `summary` field by appending any present structured lines and returning the result.
edge_case_tests.expected: No exception is raised; returned string contains 'Tried: Approach A — rejected because: Reason A'; if no structured fields existed, the return would be an empty string.
edge_case_tests.assertion_pseudocode:
result = compose_enriched_summary(summary='', rejected_approaches=[{'approach': 'Approach A', 'reason': 'Reason A'}], gotchas=[], assumptions=[])
assert 'Tried: Approach A — rejected because: Reason A' in result

result_empty = compose_enriched_summary(summary='', rejected_approaches=[], gotchas=[], assumptions=[])
assert result_empty == ''

edge_case_tests.description: Verify that sections in the composed output are separated by newline characters with no trailing newline after the final section.
edge_case_tests.expected: Sections are separated by newline characters; the string does not end with a trailing newline.
edge_case_tests.assertion_pseudocode:
result = compose_enriched_summary(summary='Core narrative.', rejected_approaches=[{'approach': 'Approach X', 'reason': 'Reason X'}], gotchas=['Watch this'], assumptions=['Assumes Y'])
assert '\n' in result
assert not result.endswith('\n')
parts = result.split('\n')
assert parts[0] == 'Core narrative.' or parts[0].startswith('Core narrative.')

smoke_tests.trigger: Call the session lifecycle's summary extraction and storage flow with a session-summary.json containing summary, rejected_approaches, gotchas, and assumptions.
mockable: Coder agent (replaced by fixture session-summary.json on disk)
File system read (can use temp directory with fixture JSON)
expected_effects: compose_enriched_summary is called once with the structured fields from the JSON
The session_summaries table contains exactly one new row for the session
The stored summary column starts with the narrative summary text
